purpose: pre-pull the exact pinned gnark wrapper image outside the proving unit so the final Groth16 wrap never pulls mid-run

pull.executed_from: interactive login shell (docker group present), outside any systemd unit
pull.status_line: Status: Image is up to date for ghcr.io/succinctlabs/sp1-gnark:v6.1.0

inspect.command: docker inspect ghcr.io/succinctlabs/sp1-gnark:v6.1.0 --format id={{.Id}} repo_digest={{index .RepoDigests 0}} size={{.Size}} created={{.Created}} arch={{.Architecture}}

docker_modifications: none beyond the image pull itself
